analysis:
Examined both BASE documentation excerpts and the supplied partial patch against the canonical definition index and detailed T-041. Existing contracts cover authenticated prefix scopes (inference.md BASE 524–550, 1108–1170), media exclusion from checkpoint reuse and bounded decoding (805–833), native retirement and memory ownership (835–845), calibration/cancellation accounting (934–1070), and manifest-bound GLM loading (674–697). These surrounding contracts are not new regressions.
The patch adds manifest-aggregate weight-hash publication and metadata-based registration reuse (HEAD 684–691), replacing separate WeightHasher passes while promising verification before serving. Integration must examine GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256, ProviderLoop.verifiedGLM5NextWeightHash and VerifiedWeightHashStore for manifest provenance, construction-time file identity checks, and whether registration/routing can mistake cached identity for verified resident weights (A-004, T-012, T-027, T-034). No implementation is supplied here, so a bypass is not established.
The partial video patch replaces the constant-frame-rate description with presentation-order decoding and average-rate timing (HEAD 818–821; BASE 810–813). Reconcile the complete changed refusal language with GLM5NextProcessor sampling, decoded/prepared-byte limits, and plaintext custody (A-001, TB-007, T-050). The patch truncates before completing that contract; BASE 827's variable-frame-rate refusal cannot establish HEAD behavior. Other HEAD additions at 884–903 and 1740–1759 are not present in these units. No concrete regression is independently supported by the supplied documentation-only evidence; implementation and remaining changed-text review are needed.
